description: These nine scene paths were acquired in the actual official Unitree MuJoCo snapshot. A model name or message-capacity candidate is not compatibility qualification. Root must pin its exact model/include/mesh closure, actual actuator/sensor/slot map, mode_machine and native SDK/CRC inputs, then retain an actual native-model run. No physical actuation is supported by this fixture.
common_native_fixture: Actual official Go20 or HG35 LowCmd/LowState, official SDK2 Python CRC, real synchronous MuJoCo and separate native DDS/ROS2 peer. The separate direct-runtime sampled-hold selection compares compiled native C++ and actual typed GO/HG Guest using the same SDK helper, full-carrier native state words and CRC. These implementations are not executed results. Sampled-q hold proves protocol/mapping/control composition and finite physics only; it is not balance, locomotion or firmware qualification.
legacy_ros1: Official unitree_ros_to_real uses different camelCase message fields and CRC layout. Its native legacy bridge and external legged SDK are separate prerequisites. No SDK2/ROS2 result qualifies that ROS1 native behavior.
optional_vision: The actor can render an actual named model camera or explicit derived MuJoCo free camera -1 with a selected CPU OSMesa backend. RGB bytes/hash/pixel tolerance are retained; unrendered physics, a free camera and synthetic modular distance arithmetic do not prove image perception or native robot camera-driver compatibility.
